class.name: litegrip_ros2_control/LitegripSystem
class.description:
The ros2_control hardware interface for the LiteGrip gripper (single joint), backed directly by the litegrip_cpp SDK.
It is a thin shell: the SDK's ControlLoop owns the CAN device, the trajectory rate ceiling, the torque budget, the red-line safety gate and the DM MIT frame stream, on its own thread. This component only parses the URDF parameters, drives the loop's lifecycle, copies the loop's cached state into the state interfaces and posts one converted target per cycle, so read()/write() stay cheap and free of I/O.
Interface surface: command exposes position only (DM MIT position control underneath); state exposes position/velocity/effort, matching the arm joints, plus diagnostics.
